note: Independently rejudged 2026-10-22 against draft-ietf-idr-linklocal-capability-06 Section 6: "If the Next Hop field is malformed, the implementation MUST handle the malformed UPDATE message using the approach of "treat-as-withdraw", as described in section 7.3 of [RFC7606]." Section 6 limits these procedures: "These procedures apply only when the Link-Local Next Hop Capability has been negotiated for a BGP session." Read all five tagged test functions, including helper bodies and both polarities within the receiving-pair tests. TestLinkLocalCapabilityMalformedThirtyTwoOctet requires exact TreatAsWithdraw, MP_REACH attribute code and the specific draft diagnostic for bad address roles; TestLinkLocalCapabilityWellFormedThirtyTwoOctet requires ActionNone for global/link-local, unspecified/link-local and two-link-local forms admitted by the surrounding section. TestRFC2545ReceivedPairSecondAddressValidated and TestRFC2545ReceivedPairFirstAddressValidated cross Session.processMessage with real MP and capability-77 negotiation, vary receiving and sending capability independently, and distinguish receipt-time treat-as-withdraw from later egress withholding. rfc2545ReceiveForwardPublished requires the Session to stay up, publish no announcements for malformed input and retain actual published cache entries; rfc2545AssertWithdrawnAtReceipt requires the exact native withdrawal and, for mixed input, the exact legacy withdrawal, then forbids downstream announcements. TestRFC2545EffectivePairPolicyAndMixedSibling keeps cap77-source-invalid-second-withdrawn with no replacement policy, so its negative proves withdrawal of every contained route at receipt, not an unasserted policy-ordering claim. Its other raw-policy cases now configure explicit FinalAccept but do not weaken that negative. validateRFC7606Attrs reads the receiving Session capability and calls ValidateUpdateRFC7606AddPath/validateLinkLocalNextHopPair; applyRFC7606 passes TreatAsWithdraw into processValidatedMessage, whose explicit branch calls SynthesizeWithdrawFamilies with mpFamilyDispatchable and dispatches the resulting withdrawals. Thus the producing verdict has a real consuming branch, not a no-op. The shared fixture now uses explicit MP negotiation on both Peer and Session; the dedicated pair helpers already negotiate their IPv6 and mixed-family subjects explicitly. Receipt controls are not evidence for neighbor liveness, interface association, or forwarding through the second address. The former comment-only narrative is stale, but its narrower statement about receipt rather than before-policy ordering remains correct. No new defect found. Native record freshness is separate and remains parent-owned; no build, test, discriminator or gate was run here.
